name: project-overlord
description: Spatial event-site planning platform for Clockwork AV (Kolkata).

scripts.typecheck: prisma generate --schema apps/api-sp/prisma/schema.prisma && tsc -b && tsc -p packages/geo-core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/scene/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/geom2/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/commands/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/layout/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/boq/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/api-sp/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/web-sp/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test -w @overlord/boq && npm run test -w @overlord/api-sp && npm run test -w @overlord/web-sp
scripts.smoke: playwright test e2e/offline.spec.ts e2e/persistence.spec.ts e2e/editing.spec.ts e2e/drawing.spec.ts
